name: High Knees

instructions.description: Stand tall and begin marching in place for a brief warm-up.
Increase speed so you run in place while lifting the knees toward hip height as tolerated.
Pump the arms naturally and land lightly on the balls of the feet.
Slow back to an easy march to recover at the end of the interval.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short intervals with good posture.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a slower marching rhythm for a lower-impact version.

commentsNotes: Keep the torso upright rather than leaning back.
Lift only as high as you can without losing rhythm.
